m.s: Rinse {quinoa} well in a sieve, as it stops it tasting bitter. Simmer in a saucepan with twice its volume of salted water for 12 minutes until the little tails pop out. Take it off the heat, cover and leave for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Pat {prawns} dry with paper towel so they sear rather than stew. Toss with {garlic*0.5} (crushed), sliced {chilli} and a pinch of salt.

Heat a splash of oil in a big frying pan over high heat. Add {broccolini} and {snowpeas} with 2 tbsp water, cover and steam-fry for 2 minutes. Uncover and cook 1 minute more until charred in spots. Tip out.
Add a little more oil, then the prawns in a single layer, in batches if needed. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes a side until just pink and curled. Overcooked prawns go rubbery.
Toss the quinoa with the zest and juice of {lemon}, the rest of the garlic, chopped {parsley}, a drizzle of oil and a pinch of salt.
Pile the greens and prawns over the lemon quinoa and crumble over {fetta}.

l: Great cold. Pack the quinoa with the greens and prawns on top and the fetta separate. Best eaten within a day.
g: Naturally gluten free. Nothing to swap.
